_meta.note: Source of truth for the per-player /play room. Gemini-generated locale files (room.<loc>.json) are consumed by scripts/i18n-room-build.mjs, which embeds an all-locale dict + bootstrap into public/game.html. The room is shared (no locale in URL); each player sees their own language via localStorage hk_lang. static = filled into [data-i18n] on load; runtime = used by public/game.js via t(). Do not hand-edit generated blocks.
